title: Safe database credential setup diagnostics
summary: Replaced the generic setup failure with specific fixed messages without revealing credential input or exception details.

changes.detail: Identify URI, project/user, port, database, placeholder password, fragment, query-option, permission, encryption and save failures using safe fixed messages. Preserve hidden input, DPAPI encryption and production checks.

validation.name: Interactive setup
validation.detail: User retry required to identify the original failure; credential storage and database access remain unverified. No database, migration or deployment operation performed.
